title: Josiah's Great Passover
reflectionText: The gatekeepers stood at every gate through the whole day and never left them. Their brothers the Levites prepared their portion and carried it out to them. What is it to be remembered by the people working beside you, when you cannot leave the gate you were given?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-08-01, Batch I.
